moments_shape.name: moments_shape
moments_shape.value:
((mode IN ('count_up','countdown') AND cycle IS NULL AND weekday IS NULL AND day_of_month IS NULL)
        OR (mode = 'periodic' AND cycle IS NOT NULL
            AND ((cycle = 'daily' AND weekday IS NULL AND day_of_month IS NULL)
              OR (cycle = 'weekly' AND weekday IS NOT NULL AND weekday BETWEEN 0 AND 6 AND day_of_month IS NULL)
              OR (cycle = 'monthly' AND day_of_month IS NOT NULL AND day_of_month BETWEEN 1 AND 31 AND weekday IS NULL)
              OR (cycle = 'yearly' AND weekday IS NULL AND day_of_month IS NULL))))

projects_team_or_owner_check.name: projects_team_or_owner_check
projects_team_or_owner_check.value: ("projects"."team_id" IS NOT NULL) <> ("projects"."owner_id" IS NOT NULL)

tags_team_or_owner_check.name: tags_team_or_owner_check
tags_team_or_owner_check.value: ("tags"."team_id" IS NOT NULL) <> ("tags"."owner_id" IS NOT NULL)
